components.name: Chord Notepad user guide

components.name: Chord Notepad logo
components.note: The logo (the launcher icon) is not under the AGPL: the terms below say what you may do with it.

components.name: CPython
components.note: The Python interpreter and standard library, as packaged by Chaquopy.

components.name: Chaquopy
components.note: Runs Python inside the app (Java runtime and native bridge).

components.name: OpenSSL
components.note: Bundled by Chaquopy for Python's ssl and hashlib modules.

components.name: SQLite
components.note: Bundled by Chaquopy for Python's sqlite3 module.

components.name: libffi
components.note: Used by Python's ctypes module (version as built by Chaquopy 17.2.0).

components.name: zlib
components.note: Used by Python's zlib module (version as built by Chaquopy 17.2.0).

components.name: XZ Utils (liblzma)
components.note: Used by Python's lzma module (version as built by Chaquopy 17.2.0). liblzma is in the public domain or under 0BSD.

components.name: bzip2
components.note: Used by Python's bz2 module (version as built by Chaquopy 17.2.0).

components.name: Expat
components.note: XML parser in Python's pyexpat module.

components.name: mpdecimal (libmpdec)
components.note: Decimal arithmetic in Python's decimal module.

components.name: Zstandard
components.note: Used by Python's compression.zstd module. Zstandard is dual-licensed (BSD or GPL-2.0); the BSD licence applies here.

components.name: Mozilla CA certificate bundle
components.note: cacert.pem, shipped with Chaquopy and again by the certifi package. The app has no network access; it is bundled with Python only.

components.name: FluidSynth
components.note: The synthesizer that plays the chords, built from the source tree linked here (the exact version this app uses, with the build script android/native/build.sh) and loaded as a separate shared library, so you can rebuild it and replace it in a build of this app. Upstream: https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth

components.name: libsndfile
components.copyright: Erik de Castro Lopo and contributors
components.note: Reads the SoundFont for FluidSynth. Built from the source linked here, as a separate shared library. Upstream: https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile

components.name: Oboe
components.note: Low-latency audio output for FluidSynth.

components.name: libogg
components.note: Codec dependency of libsndfile.

components.name: libvorbis
components.note: Codec dependency of libsndfile.

components.name: FLAC
components.note: Codec dependency of libsndfile (libFLAC only).

components.name: Opus
components.note: Codec dependency of libsndfile.

components.name: Signalsmith DSP library
components.note: Header-only; part of FluidSynth's reverb and limiter.

components.name: Signalsmith Linear
components.note: Header-only; part of FluidSynth's reverb and limiter.

components.name: Signalsmith Hilbert
components.note: Header-only; part of FluidSynth's reverb and limiter.

components.name: LLVM libc++ (libc++_shared)
components.note: C++ runtime from Android NDK r27 (27.3.13750724).

components.name: pyFluidSynth
components.note: Python bindings for FluidSynth. The package metadata says MIT, but its LICENSE file and source header say LGPL 2.1, which is what applies here. Pure Python, so you can replace it in a rebuild.

components.name: music21
components.note: Without its corpus and scale data files, which this app doesn't use.

components.name: chardet
components.note: Pure Python, so you can replace it in a rebuild. Versions below 7 only.

components.name: Requests
components.note: A dependency of music21.

components.name: GeneralUser GS
components.note: The SoundFont (instrument sounds) the app plays with.

components.name: Bravura
components.note: The clef, note head and accidental images in the chord sheet's staff view are rendered from the Bravura music font (SMuFL).

components.name: Material Design Icons
components.note: The app's toolbar, player, menu and sheet icons (from the @mdi/svg package; the icons are Apache-2.0).

components.name: Material Icons
components.note: The arrow in the Convert notation icon (arrow_right_alt) and a few screen icons (settings, help and about pages).

components.name: Sphinx
components.note: Builds the user guide; the guide's search and navigation scripts and its base styles come from Sphinx.

components.name: Read the Docs Sphinx theme
components.copyright: 2013-2018 Dave Snider, Read the Docs, Inc. & contributors
components.note: The user guide's page layout, styles and scripts.

components.name: jQuery
components.note: Used by the user guide's theme; added by sphinxcontrib-jquery 4.1.

components.name: Snowball stemmers
components.copyright: 2001 Dr Martin Porter, 2004-2005 Richard Boulton, 2013 Yoshiki Shibukawa, 2006-2019 Olly Betts
components.note: Let the user guide's search match different forms of a word (base-stemmer.js and english-stemmer.js, generated by Snowball and shipped with Sphinx).

components.name: Pygments
components.note: The colours of the user guide's code examples (pygments.css, written by Pygments).

components.name: Font Awesome
components.note: The user guide's icons, shipped with its theme. The font is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; its CSS (part of the theme's theme.css) under the MIT License.

components.name: Lato
components.note: The user guide's text font, shipped with its theme.

components.name: Roboto Slab
components.note: The user guide's heading font, shipped with its theme.
